visual_connections.description: Pathologist accesses labeling platform in Kubernetes/EKS
Hospital uploads medical image data (5TB) to S3
Images retrieved from S3 to EKS for labeling
Enriched/labeled data returned to S3 bucket
Enriched data fed into SageMaker for model training
Trained model stored in S3 bucket
Model exported to Kubernetes/EKS for validation/inference under HDS certification
SageMaker connected with FSx for high performance storage
SageMaker uses IAM for access control and security
